samples.xml_description:
<module id="adder_16bit">
    <description>Implement a 16-bit full adder with 8-bit adders in combinational logic.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit input operand A.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit input operand B.</input>
        <input id="Cin">Carry-in input.</input>
        <output id="y" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit output representing the sum of A and B.</output>
        <output id="Co">Carry-out output.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Uses two 8-bit adders to perform addition. The first 8-bit adder adds a[7:0] and b[7:0], and the second 8-bit adder adds a[15:8] and b[15:8]. The carry-out of the first 8-bit adder is added to the carry-in of the second 8-bit adder.</implementation>
</module>
